cases.title: Automatic Focus on Page Load
cases.description: Verify that upon loading the webpage, the textarea element with data-testid='choices-textarea' automatically receives focus.

cases.title: Dynamic Tag Rendering and Trimming
cases.description: Verify that comma-separated inputs entered into the textarea are dynamically parsed, leading/trailing spaces are trimmed, empty entries are ignored, and valid choices are rendered as span elements with class 'tag' and unique 'tag-{index}' data-id attributes inside data-testid='tags-container'.

cases.title: Enter Key Triggers Clearing and Random Selection Animation
cases.description: Verify that pressing the 'Enter' key clears the textarea and initiates a 3-second random selection process (30 iterations at 100ms intervals) that toggles the 'highlight' class on tags, culminating in one final highlighted tag.

cases.title: Invalid Input Handling on Enter Key
cases.description: Verify that when the user enters only commas, special characters, or empty input and presses 'Enter', the tags container remains empty and no random selection process occurs.

opinions.feedback: All test cases are well-defined, distinct, cover all requirements accurately, and are fully testable without any blockers.

analysis.analysis:
Requirement e2edev_bench_66-R-1: Testable behavior includes automatic focus on 'choices-textarea' on page load, dynamic parsing of comma-separated inputs into tags in 'tags-container', clearing textarea on 'Enter', and a 3-second random highlighting sequence (30 iterations, 100ms intervals) using class 'highlight' and unique 'tag-{index}' data-id attributes. Boundaries include the exact timing (3s, 100ms) and iteration count (30). Normal paths involve typing valid comma-separated text and pressing Enter. Abnormal paths include missing input or invalid triggers. Ambiguities include whether existing tags are cleared or appended when Enter is pressed.

Requirement e2edev_bench_66-R-2: Testable behavior focuses on comma-separated inputs, trimming spaces, ignoring empty entries, and rendering span elements with class 'tag' and data-id 'tag-{index}' (1-based index). Boundaries include handling single entries, extra spaces, and empty/special character strings. Normal paths involve standard multi-choice input. Abnormal/error paths include inputs with only commas or special characters. Edge cases include redundant commas or spaces.

Requirement e2edev_bench_66-R-3: Testable behavior specifies clearing the textarea on Enter, parsing non-empty trimmed choices into tags, conditional prevention of random selection if no valid choices exist, executing the 3-second/30-iteration highlighting animation, and final selection. Boundaries include empty inputs and pure comma strings where no tags should form and no selection should initiate. Normal paths involve standard valid input and selection. Abnormal paths include empty or invalid input resulting in an empty tags container and no selection process.
